paragraphs: Here's what this passage teaches, friend: God leads His people one stop at a time, and He leads them all the way. Camp after camp, valley after valley, they keep moving, and at Beer the LORD says to Moses, "Gather the people so that I may give them water." (Numbers 21:16) He doesn't just point the way. He provides along it. And when the people sing at that well, I think they know exactly who to thank.

Then two kings stand in the road, and look at the difference. Israel asks Sihon politely to pass through, and Sihon gathers his whole army and fights (Numbers 21:22-23). When Og comes out with his whole army at Edrei, the LORD tells Moses, "Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand…" (Numbers 21:34). Friend, I was BRAVE about a junk drawer, but nobody is walking up to an army with a smile on their face unless God already said it was handled!

So what does this mean for you, baker? Your road has big stretches and big opponents too, and the question is who goes before you. Israel moved forward because the LORD told them not to fear, not because they felt strong. Take that word with you today, and keep your oven ready and your feet moving.
